subject: Overlapping setup flags and matching-only syntax
finding: NORMAL/JOINT0 and REFLECTION/JOINT1 share enum values. Shared-vertex setup also has MUST_MATCH conditions using bitwise OR, which are always true for these nonzero constants; non-MUST_MATCH compiles the same blocks unconditionally. Do not infer per-joint gating from the enum names alone.

evidence.why: Joint/setup masks and matching-only OR conditions.
